transformation: Exact HTTP object metadata, the first 1 MiB source range, the complete source artifact, and four deterministic target-period COPY extracts are pinned by digest. PostgreSQL 15 pg_restore inventories and selectively extracts the archive in a network-disabled, read-only, memory-capped container. Each zstd-3 storage copy passes a frame test and full decompressed SHA-256 comparison with its COPY extract. The fixture maps catalog entries, DDL declarations, whole-artifact validation, extract conservation, and lossless stored-artifact evidence into ordered JSON.

scenarios: exact HTTP object identity and one-MiB range digest
whole-artifact SHA-256 and complete catalog inventory
lossless zstd storage artifacts with decompressed digest proof
explicit value-level replay and temporary-storage evidence boundaries
